metadata.question: Does the green leaf area in China increase during 2017 compared to 2000?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Region: China boundary from FAO/GAUL level0 (ADM0_NAME='China'), simplified to reduce complexity.
   - Primary dataset: MODIS LAI (MODIS/061/MOD15A2H, band 'Lai') for 2000 and 2017.
   - Fallback: MODIS NDVI (MODIS/006/MOD13Q1, band 'NDVI', QA 'SummaryQA') if LAI is unavailable in any target year.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
   - LAI: scale by 0.1, keep 0<Lai<=10.
   - NDVI: scale by 0.0001 and mask with SummaryQA <= 1 (good/marginal).
   - Compute valid pixel counts and fraction (proxy for cloud/invalid filtering).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
   - If collections are empty for a year even after fallback: C1.
   - If valid pixel count after masking is 0: C2.
   - If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible ranges (LAI 0–10, NDVI -0.2–1): C3.
   - Otherwise compare 2017 mean vs 2000 mean; increase -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function buildChinaGeometry() {
  const fc = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'China'));
  // Simplify to reduce processing load.
  return fc.geometry().simplify(5000);
}

function buildLAICollection(year) {
  const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD15A2H')
    .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-12-31`)
    .select(['Lai'])
    .map(img => {
      const lai = img.select('Lai').multiply(0.1);
      const m = lai.gt(0).and(lai.lte(10));
      return lai.updateMask(m).rename('metric');
    });
  return col;
}

function buildNDVICollection(year) {
  const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1')
    .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-12-31`)
    .select(['NDVI', 'SummaryQA'])
    .map(img => {
      const mask = img.select('SummaryQA').lte(1);
      const ndvi = img.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001).updateMask(mask);
      return ndvi.rename('metric');
    });
  return col;
}

async function yearStats(col, geom, scale) {
  const size = await getInfo(col.size());
  if (size === 0) {
    return { empty: true, images: 0 };
  }
  const meanImg = col.mean().rename('metric');
  const validCount = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e10
  }).get('metric'));
  const totalCount = await getInfo(ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e10
  }).get('c'));
  if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
    return { empty: false, noValid: true, images: size, valid: 0, total: totalCount || 0 };
  }
  const meanVal = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e10
  }).get('metric'));
  return {
    empty: false,
    images: size,
    mean: meanVal,
    valid: validCount,
    total: totalCount
  };
}

function plausible(value, metric) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return false;
  if (isNaN(value)) return false;
  if (metric === 'LAI') {
    return value >= 0 && value <= 10;
  } else if (metric === 'NDVI') {
    return value >= -0.2 && value <= 1.0;
  }
  return true;
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    const geom = buildChinaGeometry();
    const scale = 3000; // coarse scale for national aggregation
    const y1 = 2000;
    const y2 = 2017;

    // Try LAI first for both years
    let metric = 'LAI';
    let col1 = buildLAICollection(y1);
    let col2 = buildLAICollection(y2);
    let size1 = await getInfo(col1.size());
    let size2 = await getInfo(col2.size());
    if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) {
      // Fallback to NDVI for both years
      metric = 'NDVI';
      col1 = buildNDVICollection(y1);
      col2 = buildNDVICollection(y2);
      size1 = await getInfo(col1.size());
      size2 = await getInfo(col2.size());
      if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) {
        console.log(`Dataset fallback failed. ${y1} images: ${size1}, ${y2} images: ${size2}`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    const stats1 = await yearStats(col1, geom, scale);
    const stats2 = await yearStats(col2, geom, scale);

    if (stats1.empty || stats2.empty) {
      console.log(`Empty collections after selection. ${y1}: ${stats1.images || 0}, ${y2}: ${stats2.images || 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (stats1.noValid || stats2.noValid) {
      console.log(`No valid pixels after masking. ${y1} valid: ${stats1.valid || 0}, ${y2} valid: ${stats2.valid || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (!plausible(stats1.mean, metric) || !plausible(stats2.mean, metric)) {
      console.log(`Invalid means. ${y1}: ${stats1.mean}, ${y2}: ${stats2.mean}, metric: ${metric}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const frac1 = stats1.total ? (stats1.valid / stats1.total) : null;
    const frac2 = stats2.total ? (stats2.valid / stats2.total) : null;
    const diff = stats2.mean - stats1.mean;

    console.log(`Dataset: ${metric === 'LAI' ? 'MODIS LAI (MOD15A2H)' : 'MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1)'}`);
    console.log(`${y1} Images: ${stats1.images}, Valid px: ${stats1.valid}/${stats1.total} (${(frac1*100).toFixed(1)}%), Mean ${metric}: ${stats1.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`${y2} Images: ${stats2.images}, Valid px: ${stats2.valid}/${stats2.total} (${(frac2*100).toFixed(1)}%), Mean ${metric}: ${stats2.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Diff ${metric} (2017-2000): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
